::: {#thm-noise-second-moment}

#### The second moment of mean-zero noise

Let $\noise$ be a random variable with $\Ep[\noise] = 0$ and $\Var{\noise} = \varpar$.
Then

$$\Ep[\noise^2] = \varpar$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-noise-second-moment, worked in @sol-noise-second-moment.
It rearranges @thm-variance, using $\Ep[\noise] = 0$.

:::
